text:
Maria G.: Quick sync — ACME wants a 3-week POC. We need a final decision on hosting mode (Hosted / Dedicated / Private) + answers for their security questionnaire by EOD Friday. Can we align here?

Jamal K.: Quick Qs — what traffic / latency do they expect? Any PII or residency constraints?

Oliver P.: From presales notes: EU residency required, SOC2 scope expected, estimate ~50 req/s typical, up to 200 req/s burst during peak. Data classification: customer-identifiable but not extremely sensitive (no SSNs) — still need clear KMS + audit logs.

Maria G.: Correct on residency and SOC2. They also flagged encryption-at-rest + key control and an on-prem option if the legal team insists. Pricing question from buyer: delta vs hosted for 3-week POC and what Dedicated setup time looks like.

Nora S.: Security checklist highlights (short):
```
- Data residency: EU tenant + enforced region routing
- Encryption: TLS1.2+ in transit, AES-256 at rest
- Key mgmt: customer-managed KMS/HSM (required for Private; optional for Dedicated)
- Audit: request/response logs retention (30d default, can increase)
- Pen test: share recent pentest report + remediation list
```
I'll drop our questionnaire link: https://redwood.internal/sec/ACME-SSQ (private link).

Salesbot: Quick estimate (POC, 3 weeks):
```
- Hosted (standard): setup <1 day, cost est ~$5k for expected tokens
- Dedicated (reserved pool): setup 3-5 business days, est ~$18k + infra commit
- Private (VPC / on-prem): setup 2-4 weeks, professional services + license, est ~$45k
```
Numbers are rough — engineering to confirm.

Jamal K.: For success criteria proposal:
```
1) Functional: 95% of target prompts produce acceptable answers (buyer QA rubric)
2) Latency: p95 < 500ms for single-turn requests in EU region
3) Throughput: sustain 50 req/s for 30m window without errors
4) Cost: <= cost threshold in proposal (TBD)
5) Security: pass ACME SSQ items flagged as "must"
```
Eval plan: run 3 prompt buckets (core use-case, edge-case paraphrases, adversarial prompts). Collect human eval on 200 samples.

Oliver P.: Implementation notes for hosting decision:
- If ACME can tolerate hosted: fastest and lowest friction; we can pin model version + EU routing.
- Dedicated if they need predictable throughput and isolation (still within our infra, faster spin-up than Private).
- Private only if legal insists on managed VPC or on-prem; needs SRE + PS involvement.

Maria G.: Buyer wants a price + minimal friction option. My read: propose Hosted + EU routing as default, offer Dedicated as an elevated option (with clear lead time), and state Private as last resort. Can we draft a one-pager with expected costs, timelines, and security hits?

Nora S.: I can answer SSQ "must" items by tomorrow. For Hosted we need explicit KMS assurance and data processing addendum — legal should review with ACME.

Jamal K.: I'll assemble the prompt set and the 200-sample human eval plan by Wednesday. Also need engineering to confirm p95 numbers and Dedicated provisioning lead time.

Oliver P.: Eng estimate: Dedicated provisioning 3 business days if capacity available; otherwise queue could add 1 week. Private: non-trivial — 2-4 weeks with PS. Will confirm after capacity check.

Maria G.: Action items:
- Nora: complete SSQ "must" answers (owner) — due tomorrow
- Jamal: prompts + eval plan + sample set — due Wed EOD
- Oliver: confirm Dedicated capacity + realistic lead times, and update cost delta — due Tue
- Maria: draft one-pager offer (Hosted first, Dedicated alt, Private fallback) — will send to thread for review by Thu

Oliver P.: +1 on owners. Also suggest we include a short rollback plan if performance regresses (auto-fallback to smaller model / lower throughput).

Maria G.: Perfect. If we can finalize by Friday we can present to ACME next Monday. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
